title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.311 - Added `cacheCreationEphemeral5mInputTokens` and `cacheCreationEphemeral1hInputTokens` to `ModelUsage`, splitting `cacheCreationInputTokens` by cache lifetime - Changed background start-up work to wait until the first model request is sent, for about 10 seconds at most, when the first message arrives during start-up - Changed the minimum supported Node.js version from 18.0.0 to 18.14.0 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.311 ## 0.3.310 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.310 ## 0.3.309 - Fixed host-supplied `managedSettings` dropping `disableAllHooks`, `disableSkillShellExecution` and empty `allowedHttpHookUrls` / `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` lists
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
